A '''heater coil''' was an appliance used to cook [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]. The [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Eeksa]] used a heater coil to cook her afternoon meal at her business, [[Eeksa's Rare Exotics and Pets]].
